title: Beyond the Dominant Label: Recovering Coexisting Lesion Evidence with Multiple Instance Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole-slide images may contain coexisting lesions, yet weak supervision typically provides only the most severe diagnosis. We formulate this setting as dominant-label multiple instance learning, where the observed label is the maximum-severity element of a latent lesion set. Standard multiclass MIL treats it as a complete one-hot description and therefore suppresses lower-severity evidence whenever it co-occurs with a dominant lesion. We propose DomSet-MIL, a label-aware framework that aligns the annotation mechanism across bag and instance levels. Dominant-Label Censored Likelihood models the reported diagnosis without declaring unreported lesions absent. Severity-Ordered Residual Routing assigns patch evidence from high to low severity and preserves residual support for secondary findings, while top-$q$ pooling links local routing scores to bag prediction. translated_title: 超越主导标签：利用多示例学习恢复共存的病灶证据
translated_abstract: 全切片病理图像可能包含共存的病灶，然而弱监督通常只提供最严重的诊断。我们将这一场景形式化为主导标签多示例学习，其中观测到的标签是潜在病灶集合中严重程度最高的元素。标准的多分类多示例学习（MIL）将其视为完整的一位有效编码描述，因此当较低严重程度的病灶与主导病灶共存时，其证据会被抑制。我们提出了DomSet-MIL，这是一个标签感知的框架，它在包级和实例级之间对齐标注机制。主导标签删失似然建模了报告的诊断，而不会宣称未报告的病灶不存在。严重程度排序的残差路由将patch证据从高严重程度到低严重程度进行分配，并为次要发现保留残差支持，同时top-q池化将局部路由分数与包级预测联系起来。在自然和受控设置下的实验表明，DomSet-MIL 取得了……
tldr: 提出DomSet-MIL框架，通过主导标签删失似然和严重程度排序残差路由，在弱监督下恢复与主导病灶共存时的次要病灶证据，避免低严重程度病变信息被抑制。
en_tdlr: DomSet-MIL recovers coexisting lesion evidence from weakly-labeled whole-slide images via a dominant-label censored likelihood and severity-ordered residual routing, preventing secondary lesions from being suppressed by the dominant diagnosis.
